theorem wp_Restore_voters [package_sem : Assumptions] (H : confchange.Restore.spec) (chg :
    confchange.Changer) (cs : Loc) (c : ConfStateM) (dq : DFrac) (v0 : Loc) (Hvnd : c.Voters'.Nodup)
    (Hv0n : ¬W64 0 ∈ c.Voters') (Hvlen : ↑c.Voters'.length ≤ 2 ^ 62) (Hcvo : c.VotersOutgoing' = [])
    (Hcl : c.Learners' = []) (Hcln : c.LearnersNext' = []) (Hmi : 0 ≤ sint.Z
    chg.Tracker'.MaxInflight' ∧ sint.Z chg.Tracker'.MaxInflight' < 2 ^ 62) (Harr :
    chg.Tracker'.Config'.Voters'.arr = [v0, map.nil]) (Hl : chg.Tracker'.Config'.Learners' =
    map.nil) (Hln : chg.Tracker'.Config'.LearnersNext' = map.nil) (Hal :
    chg.Tracker'.Config'.AutoLeave' = false) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.confchange
    ∗ ownCSM cs dq c ∗ ownMap v0 (DFrac.own 1) ∅ ∗ ownMap chg.Tracker'.Progress' DFrac.discard ∅ -∗
    (▷ ∀ cfgv prsm, |==> (ownCSM cs dq c ∗ ∃ prs, ownConfig (listToSet c.Voters') cfgv prsm prs ∗
    ⌜prs.domSet = listToSet c.Voters'⌝) -∗ Φ ((intoVal cfgv, intoVal prsm), intoVal
    GoInterface.nil)) -∗ WP (((intoVal (functions confchange.Restore [])) (intoVal chg)) (intoVal
    cs)) {{ Φ }}
